features: Up to 50 Hours Playtime: Keep the music flowing for days without constantly searching for a power outlet. The long-lasting battery capacity combined with an efficient charging case provides up to 50 hours of total playback, comfortably covering your weekly commutes and extended workouts.

4 Mics with ENx Tech: Deliver crystal-clear vocal clarity during phone calls and virtual meetings. A quad-microphone matrix powered by ENx technology actively isolates your voice while suppressing background noise and environmental chatter, ensuring you are heard loud and clear everywhere.

Dual EQ Modes (Signature Mode | Balanced Mode): Switch your sound profile instantly to match what you are listening to. Choose boAt Signature Mode for deep, chest-thumping bass on high-energy tracks, or toggle to Balanced Mode for natural vocals and balanced frequencies ideal for podcasts and audiobooks.

13mm Drivers: Experience dynamic sound quality driven by large 13mm audio drivers. Precision-tuned to deliver full-bodied audio, they produce rich low-end punch and detailed high notes for a well-rounded listening experience across genres.

BEAST Mode (50ms Low Latency): Gain a competitive edge in mobile gaming with ultra-fast audio transmission. Activating BEAST Mode reduces latency down to a mere 50ms, ensuring sound effects and in-game cues sync instantly with the action happening on screen.
